name: Play golf in Hersham and Walton
summary: Hersham Golf Club welcomes visitors to its 18-hole course, while Burhill Golf Club has two championship courses in attractive parkland. Both are best treated as planned sporting outings, with tee times, dress expectations and visitor rates checked in advance.
reasonToVisit: Two established golf clubs within easy reach, one an 18-hole course and one championship parkland
planningDetail: Check tee-time availability, dress code and visitor rates before travelling
